products.label: Abell 2744 spectroscopic cluster members, CDS J/A+A/670/A60
products.process: Keep the catalogue's spectroscopic members; place each at the cluster's Planck 2018 comoving distance, spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky; tone by F160W magnitude.
limitations: A member's depth within the cluster is assumed (as deep as wide), not measured.
The catalogue covers the cluster core only, the field of its strong-lensing model.
